description: This Swift source file defines an enumeration 'OpenClawKitResources' responsible for locating and managing the resource bundle for the OpenClawKit module. It includes logic for checking various locations such as Bundle.main, Bundle.module, and fallback paths to reliably find the resource bundle across different deployment and development environments.
